identificationModule.briefTitle: Evaluation of Efficacy and Safety of a Single Dose of Exa-cel in Participants With Severe Sickle Cell Disease, βS/ βC Genotype
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3 Study to Evaluate Efficacy and Safety of a Single Dose of Exa-cel in Subjects With Severe Sickle Cell Disease, βS/βC Genotype

statusModule.whyStopped: Modification to the clinical development plan

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of the study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of CTX001 (exa-cel) in adolescent and adult participants with severe sickle cell disease (SCD), βS/βC genotype (HbSC).

armGroups.label: Exa-cel
armGroups.description: Participants will receive a single infusion of exa-cel (autologous CD34+ hHSPCs modified with CRISPR-Cas9 at the erythroid lineage-specific enhancer of the BCL11A gene) through a central venous catheter.

interventions.name: Exa-cel
interventions.description: Administered by intravenous (IV) infusion following myeloablative conditioning with busulfan.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Participants with documented βS/βC (HbSC) genotype
* Participants must be eligible for autologous stem cell transplant as per investigator's judgment

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* A willing and healthy 10/10 human leukocyte antigen (HLA)-matched related donor is available per investigator's judgement
* Participants with prior hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT)
* Treatment with regular RBC transfusions that, in the opinion of the investigator, cannot be interrupted after engraftment.

Other protocol defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria may apply.
